{{family name hatnote|Rubio|Gómez|lang=Catalan}}
'''Jesús Rubio Gómez''', known as '''Jesús Rubio''', '''Chus Rubio''' or '''Txus Rubio''' (born 9 September 1994), is an Andorran professional [[association football|football]]er. He plays for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team]].

==International==
He made his debut for the [[Andorra national football team]] on 12 November 2015 in a friendly game against [[Saint Kitts and Nevis national football team|Saint Kitts and Nevis]].<ref>{{cite web|publisher=[[Sky Sports]]|url=http://www.skysports.com/football/andorra-vs-st-kitts-and-nevis/live/352036|title=Game Report by Sky Sports|date=12 November 2015}}</ref> On June 10, 2022, he scored his first goal with the national team against [[Liechtenstein national football team|Liechtenstein]], a spectacular goal with a 60-meter lob.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://rmcsport.bfmtv.com/football/ligue-des-nations/ligue-des-nations-le-but-incroyable-d-andorre-sur-un-lob-de-60-metres_AV-202206100695.html|title=Ligue des nations: le but incroyable d'Andorre sur un lob de 60 mètres|website=[[RMC Sport]]|date=11 June 2022|language=French}}</ref> Thanks to this goal, the second for Andorra in this match, the Pyrenean team beat [[Liechtenstein national football team|Liechtenstein]] at home (2–1), this game was part of the [[2022–23 UEFA Nations League D|2022–23 UEFA Nations League]].
